newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes up in nearby Nov and chases cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes up in nearby Nov and chases cash.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed with nearby November higher as that contract attempted to keep up with the cash market, traders said.
"It's obvious the market was converging with cash today," a trader said. But "there was selling in the January and March on the way up."
Traders cited bull spreading of the January/September and said the November now has rallied to levels that may restrict business.
Rice closed seven cents per cwt higher to four lower, with November up seven at $10.24 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 500 contracts, about the same as Monday's 503. Rice options volume was estimated at 40 contracts, up from 11 Monday.
